# Early AF

> Market research and marketing guidance for solo app builders. Free daily idea plus Reply Radar (listen → score → queue for manual reply). Not a hub, agency tool, auto-reply product, or full marketing suite.

Early AF (earlyaf.ai) helps solo app builders find realistic opportunities, understand who needs them, and show up in public conversations worth answering by hand.

## What you get today

- [Home](https://earlyaf.ai/): Wedge overview — free daily idea, Reply Radar, research → first experiment
- [Blog](https://earlyaf.ai/blog): Long-form guides for solo builders (idea discovery, audience research, worth-reply)
- [How to find app ideas people actually need](https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-find-app-ideas-people-need): Method for spotting recurring problems before you code
- [How to research your app audience before you build features](https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-research-your-app-audience): Naming who has the problem from real conversations and reviews
- [When a customer complaint is a build signal](https://earlyaf.ai/blog/when-a-customer-complaint-is-a-build-signal): When a complaint earns a small experiment — not a product from one rant
- [When a Reddit or X reply is worth your time](https://earlyaf.ai/blog/when-a-reddit-or-x-reply-is-worth-your-time): Solo-builder filter for which public posts deserve a manual reply
- [Reply Radar (GitHub)](https://github.com/robbybuilds/early-af-reply-radar): Chrome extension — listen on Reddit/X, score for ICP fit, queue locally; you reply yourself

## Honest limits

- No auto-listen-as-a-service hub today (north-star ambition only)
- No auto-reply, DMs, or outreach blasts
- No ads suite, rankings promises, or invented engagement volumes
- Agencies are not the ICP we write for today
